acceptanceCriteria: A claim, widen or closeout whose diff touches docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv, docs/specs/INDEX.json or docs/specs/README.md does not refuse RESOURCE_COLLISION solely because another live attempt also lists those generated files
The rule is declared once (policy or reservation class), not per lane, and a regression test reproduces the V1-1639 vs V1-0812 collision
Hand-authored paths keep exclusive collision semantics
body: Observed 2026-10-20, corvint-tasks local build. Every spec change regenerates docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv, INDEX.json and README.md (make spec-requirements), so every spec-touching ticket's closeout widen/submit must include them. Tasks treats them as exclusive PATH resources. V1-1639's cem-verdict closeout (widen to base..seal paths) refused RESOURCE_COLLISION because the parked V1-0812 attempt (waiting on an owner CI post) listed the same three generated files; the closeout script then released and the attempt was CANCELLED. Workaround: release V1-0812 and re-claim without the generated files, re-claim V1-1639. Expected: derived files that are regenerated at merge (V1-1525 already makes them merge-regenerated) are shared or exempt reservation resources. Actual: exclusive, blocking unrelated closeouts for as long as any spec lane is parked.

title: Tasks reservations treat generated spec index files as exclusive, so any parked spec lane blocks every other spec ticket's closeout
